description: This file defines a custom exception class `LoanChargeCannotBeDeletedException` used to signal specific rules for deleting loan charges in the system. It includes an internal enum `LoanChargeCannotBeDeletedReason` to specify reasons why a charge cannot be deleted, each with associated error messages and codes.

classes.name: LoanChargeCannotBeDeletedException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a loan charge cannot be deleted, parameterized by specific reasons and the charge ID.

methods.name: LoanChargeCannotBeDeletedException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a specific reason and loan charge ID, passing appropriate error code and message to the superclass.
